home.title: Orca
home.connectDescription: Pair with Orca on your computer to view terminals, check progress, and control your workflow from anywhere.
home.step2Desc: Tap the button above and scan the QR code on your computer.
home.step3Desc: Your desktop will appear here. Tap it to get started.
home.desktopUpdateRequired: Update desktop Orca and sign in to connect from anywhere

settings.title: Settings
settings.cleanupFailed: Cleanup still couldn't be confirmed on some hosts
settings.cleanupConfirmFailed: Couldn't confirm cleanup for all hosts

onboarding.howSessionsDesc: Choose whether supported agent sessions open in a chat-like view or terminal view on this device.
onboarding.stayUpdatedDesc: Get notified on this device when an agent finishes or needs attention.
onboarding.choiceSaveFailed: Your choice could not be saved. Try again.
onboarding.notifUpdateFailed: Notification settings could not be updated. Try again.

scan.title: Pair with desktop
scan.notValidQr: Not a valid Orca QR code
scan.notValidCode: Not a valid pairing code. Make sure it starts with "{{scheme}}://pair?code=".
scan.scanInstructions: Scan the QR code from Orca on your desktop
scan.noCameraInstructions: Enable camera access in Settings to scan the QR code.
scan.pasteInstructions: Copy the code shown under the QR on your computer.

confirm.title: Pair with this desktop?
confirm.description: You opened a pairing link from your desktop. Make sure the displayed desktop is yours.

settings.title: Terminal
settings.whenYouLeaveDesc: When you leave the app, fit-to-screen stops controlling the terminal rows visible. When you come back, fit-to-screen resumes.
settings.noDesktops: No paired desktops yet. Pair a desktop and select how its terminal text appears on this device.
settings.textSizeDesc: Scale the terminal text size on this device. This doesn't affect the desktop terminal.
settings.keyboardInputDesc: Some apps may behave differently with autocomplete and autocorrect enabled.

chatUi.title: Chat UI
chatUi.defaultViewDesc: Choose whether supported agent sessions open in a chat-like view or a terminal view.

settings.title: Browser
settings.linksDesc: Choose where HTTP(S) links open when tapped in sessions.

voice.title: Voice
voice.connectDesktop: Connect to a desktop to configure voice settings.
voice.dictationDesc: Dictate text into any focused pane on your desktop.
voice.toggleMode: Toggle: press once to start and stop dictation.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.disabledInSystem: Notifications are disabled in system settings.
notifications.getNotified: Get notified on this device when an agent finishes or needs attention.

differentWifi.title: Different WiFi Networks
differentWifi.steps: Make sure your phone and desktop are on the same WiFi network.

firewall.title: Firewall Blocking Port 6768
firewall.steps: Check your desktop firewall settings and allow port 6768.

desktopNotRunning.title: Desktop App Not Running
desktopNotRunning.steps: Make sure the Orca desktop app is open and running.

connectionTimeout.title: Connection Timeout
connectionTimeout.steps: The connection timed out. Make sure your devices are on the same network and try again.

tailscale.title: Tailscale Host Unreachable
tailscale.steps: Check that Tailscale is connected on both devices and the host address is correct.

otherVpn.title: Other VPN Interference
otherVpn.steps: VPNs can interfere with local connections. Try disconnecting and pairing again.

connectionLog.title: Connection log
connectionLog.noEvents: No connection events yet this session.
